stops.note: possibly literally to await what the stars will bring, from de- (from) and sidus (star)
stops.meaning: to long for, await from the stars

stops.note: carried into French for longing or wishing for something
stops.meaning: to long for, to wish for

stops.note: settled as the English word for a strong wish or longing
stops.meaning: a strong feeling of wanting something

current_meaning: a strong feeling of wanting to have or achieve something
